coordinate_frame: canonical Row-B metric frame (+Z from AprilTag frame)

method.stage_1: Recover each scene's full AprilTag basis from ordered debug/tag_border_sfm.ply points and the pre-apply-scale factor in debug/scale_report.json.
method.stage_2: Because the physical tag-to-row offset changes across dates, robustly fit a yaw+XY-translation rigid transform from six plant centres to an eight-iteration generalized-Procrustes median template. Scale is fixed at 1.0; +Z and tag height are retained. RANSAC threshold is 0.12 m.
method.scale_policy: No fitted scale is applied because all source splats were already converted to metres. A Sim(2) scale diagnostic is reported per date.
